ValidationRule.description: Expected Resources and Expected Length are required prior to updating Status to "In Review"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'In Review') || ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Approved'), ISBLANK(Expected_Resources__c) || ISBLANK(Expected_Project_Length__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Expected Resources and Expected Length are required prior to updating Status to "In Review"
